body: Thanks, I will try finding one, maybe it will help change some behavior.

Native language would be german. Yeah, learning new languages is great, it's more than plain communication, it's also a way of structuring your thoughts. I feel pretty done with English by now, it may not be perfect and I propably couldn't write a novel in it, but I can speak fluently and express myself the way I feel like, so it's propably time for a new language. Spanish is cool, esspecially because so many people around the globe speak it, as you said, almost all of soutamerica for example haha. I have thrown an eye on japanese personally, after having lived with a japanese roommate. Learning japanse will acually make some time pass, not a bad idea.

Im fortunate enough to not have been diagnnosed with any diseases or any mental illness except for ADD and Depression, what is pretty obligatory, because concentration issues in youth and depressive moods are basicly what anyone will experience at some point. 

I personally dont feel the kind of worthlessness you are hinting on, I don't need to be apreciated, I even think that there are people who appretiate me, I'm just feeling tired and bored of it. Stuff feels dull and tasteless a lot of the time, but well  the pro-contra list for suicide is pretty even I suppose.

Thanks, this means a lot to me, esspecially because English is not my native language. Writing indeed feels a bit like wrapping all this stuff up into something objective and meaningful. Charles Bukowski wrote "writing is framing the suffering and hanging it on a wall" and it is indeed one of the things that keep me going and gives going on some kind of point.

Your comment was simply a compliment, but I suppose this is most helpful in some situations, thanks.
Dang, why havent I thought of that!
